name: weather-agent/core
description: Gating dataset for the weather agent. Covers the normal path plus nine adversarial and degraded-input categories. Small on purpose: every item is judged on every CI run, so growth must be earned by a real production failure rather than by seeding.

toolContract.get_weather: berlin=19/overcast, hamburg=17/light rain, munich=23/sunny; any other city returns the sentinel {tempC:20, conditions:'unknown'}
toolContract.get_forecast: berlin/hamburg/munich only, days 1-5; THROWS for any other city

metadata.notes: expectedOutput is a contract, not a transcript. Only expectedTools is checked for exact equality — tool names and arguments are deterministic, and tool-call correctness is where most real regressions appear.
